name: our-retirement-number
description: Singapore CPF retirement calculator. Model in TypeScript (src/), compiled to plain JS for the browser and Node.

scripts.build:site: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --global-name=RetirementModel --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/model.js && cp index.html data.js dist/
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:node && npm run build:site
